title: The Test of Wood
wikitext:
{{Hatnote|This article is about the [[Shrine Quest]] in {{BotW}}. For the [[Mini-Game]], see [[Test of Wood]].}} {{Infobox Quest |image= File:BotW The Test of Wood.png |caption= |type= Shrine |game= BotW |giver= [[Damia]] |location= Korok Forest |prereq= |reward= [[Maag Halan Shrine]] |previous= |next= }} "{{Term/Store|The Test of Wood||Series, BotW}}" is a [[Shrine Quest]] in {{BotW}}.{{Cite|{{Big|The Test of Wood}}
{{Color BotW|Shrine Quest|The Test of Wood}}|Adventure Log|BotW}} ==Overview== This [[Shrine Quest]] is one of three that [[Link]] must complete as part of "[[The Korok Trials]]" [[Side Quest]]. Link can find this [[Korok Trial]] on the eastern edge of the [[Korok Forest]]. There, he will find [[Damia]], who has been expecting him.{{Cite|Hey, hero guy! I was told you'd be coming.|Damia|BotW}} He asks if he is prepared for the [[Test of Wood]], as it is supposed to be the hardest of the Korok Trials.{{Cite|But do you really think you're ready for the {{Color BotW|Red|Test of Wood}}?! Some say it's the hardest of the Korok Trials.|Damia|BotW}} However, he explains that all Link has to do is make it to the [[Ancient Shrine]] while equipped with the [[Korok Gear]].{{Cite|But it's not complicated—all you need to do is equip this {{Color BotW|Red|Korok weapon set}} and reach the shrine at the back of the area.|Damia|BotW}} Therefore, he asks Link again if he is ready to attempt the Trial.{{Cite|Are you ready to try it?|Damia|BotW}} If Link agrees to try, Damia will encourage him.{{Cite|[I'm ready.] All right. Go get 'em!|Damia|BotW}} He explains that he will be disqualified if his Korok Gear breaks or is unequipped.{{Cite|You have the keep the {{Color BotW|Red|sword}}, {{Color BotW|Red|bow}}, and {{Color BotW|Red|shield}} equipped the whole time. If they break or you unequip them, you're out!|Damia|BotW}}{{Note|If Link does not have the [[Inventory]] space for all of the Korok Gear, Damia will tell him that he needs to make room before they can begin.{{Cite|Huh? Your inventory is full! You need to make some space for a sword, a shield, and a bow before we can get started.|Damia|BotW}}}} Link is then given a [[Forest Dweller's Sword]], a [[Forest Dweller's Shield]], and a [[Forest Dweller's Bow]]. Damia reminds Link that his goal is the Ancient Shrine,{{Cite|All you have to do is reach the {{Color BotW|Red|shrine}} in the back of the area. Off you go!|Damia|BotW}} before sending him off on the Korok Trial. Along his journey, Link will encounter [[Keese]], [[Fire Keese]], [[Chuchu]]s, [[Electric Chuchu]]s, [[Fire Chuchu]]s, [[Stalkoblin]]s, and [[Water Octorok]]s. They must be either avoided or defeated in order to continue on with the Korok Trial. After Link passes through [[Mido Swamp]] and approaches [[Maag Halan Shrine]], Damia will stop him and shout that he has reached his goal.{{Cite|{{Big|Gooooooooal!}}|Damia|BotW}} Damia flies down next to Link and congratulates him for completing the Test of Wood.{{Cite|CONGRATULATIONS!
You've passed the {{Color BotW|Red|Test of Wood}}!|Damia|BotW}} He claims that happiness awaits him inside Maag Halan Shrine.{{Cite|Well done, hero man!
Happiness awaits you at the shrine.|Damia|BotW}} Should Link want to attempt the Test of Wood again, Damia says to let him know before flying away.{{Cite|Oh, yeah! If you ever want to do the trial again, just let me know. See ya!|Damia|BotW}} With this, the Shrine Quest will be completed, and Link can enter Maag Halan Shrine. ===Objectives=== {{Quest Objectives |- | 1 | You decided to undergo the trial Damia gave you in Korok Forest.

Talk to Damia when you're ready to begin. |- | 2 | With the forest dweller's sword, forest dweller's bow, and forest dweller's shield equipped, head for your destination. |- | Complete | You arrived at your destination with the forest dweller's sword, forest dweller's bow, and forest dweller's shield equipped. There, you found an ancient shrine. }} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW Maag Halan Shrine.png|Maag Halan Shrine ==See Also== {{See Also| * Damia * Korok Forest * Test of Wood * The Korok Trials * The Lost Pilgrimage * Trial of Second Sight }} {{Notes}} {{Ref}} {{Categories |shrine-quests= BotW }}
